newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KPN to launch national Internet network.
newsitem.headline: KPN to launch national Internet network.

text.p: Dutch post and telecoms group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN) said on Tuesday it would launch a national internet network from September and offer mailbox services to its eight million customers.

"With the development of these new services, investments in the technical infrastructure and the establishment of a new division called Internet Services, PTT Telecom will be making the Internet and Internet-like services part of its core businesss," KPN said in a statement.

A starter package will be available from July and, by the end of 1998, KPN expects to have connected two million users to the Internet. In co-operation with service providers, KPN's network will be connected to the worldwide internet.
Subscription will be free for the first six months and thereafter cost five guilders per month. Customers will pay the local telephone rate for use of the network.
KPN said it also plans to offer start intranet and extranet activities.
